question: On 23rd May 2026, Karnataka's first dedicated support centre for which of the following patient categories was inaugurated by the non-profit organisation 'Access Life'?
solution: The correct answer is __**Paediatric Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • **Access Life**, an Indian non-profit organisation, announced the opening of a new **‘Home Away from Home’ (HAH)** centre on **23rd May 2026**.
